doc: A software framebuffer the host shows as a texture.

constants.name: FORMAT_RGBA8
constants.doc: 4 bytes per pixel in memory order R, G, B, A

constants.name: FORMAT_RGB565
constants.doc: 2 bytes per pixel, little-endian, red in the high 5 bits

constants.name: FORMAT_INDEXED8
constants.doc: 1 byte per pixel, an index into the palette set with set_palette

constants.name: ERR_SIZE
constants.doc: width, height or stride out of range, or pixels shorter than stride * height

constants.name: ERR_PALETTE
constants.doc: palette is not a whole number of RGBA8 entries, is empty, or has more than 256

functions.name: present
functions.doc: Shows a frame. stride is the distance between rows in bytes. The host copies the pixels before returning. Returns OK or ERR_*.

functions.name: set_palette
functions.doc: Sets the palette for FORMAT_INDEXED8: up to 256 RGBA8 entries. Missing entries are opaque black. Returns OK or ERR_PALETTE.
